messages:
Kei: Heads-up: we're releasing the Private minimal-telemetry policy (v1) for on-prem and VPC deployments tonight. This is aimed at customers who require the telemetry envelope but want strict minimization. Rolling window and quick runbook below. Ping me for customer exceptions. :loudspeaker:
release-bot: Release artifact pushed: private-telemetry-policy@v1.0 -> s3://internal-releases/policies/private-telemetry/v1.0. Rollout window: 2025-08-14 23:00 UTC -> 2025-08-15 03:00 UTC. Canary: 5% first 30m.
Lina: Quick Q: default state for newly provisioned tenants?
Kei: Default = disabled. Customers can opt-in per-tenant from Console or via Management API. We will record consent metadata in onboarding.
ops-bot: Canary health checks green (us-east-1, eu-west-2). Agent heartbeats steady; no crashes in last 20m.
Lina: Any changes to agent networking?
Kei: One small change: management plane listens on 15012 now (runtime stays 15011). Please update customer firewall guidance and preflight.
support-squad: Support rota for the window: @Lina and @Kei (backup: @Sam). Please escalate connectivity or registration failures immediately.
compliance-team: Note: when enabled the telemetry envelope contains only aggregated counters and hashed metric identifiers; we explicitly exclude raw prompt content and PII. Retention default for this policy is 14 days (short window) and hashing scheme docs are in the compliance pack. We'll add a signed consent artifact to the onboarding bundle.
Kei: Short customer-prep checklist:
- Verify firewall allows TCP 15012 (management).
- If customer requires HSM-backed envelope encryption, confirm KMS/HSM creds and provide CA thumbprint.
- Decide telemetry opt-in and store consent in onboarding sheet (template to be posted).
- Run preflight script and paste results into ticket.
API example to enable telemetry for a tenant:
```
curl -X POST https://mgmt.customer.example/api/v1/tenants/5678/telemetry -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"enabled":true, "consent_note":"signed-2025-08-14"}'
```
Kei: I'll post the customer-facing FAQ and email template after this thread. Monitoring window: 4h post-rollout. Thanks all. :eyes:
